description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for customer-visible intelligence freshness. Consumed by scripts/public_freshness_contract.py (R2 stale-manifest upload guard, public feed freshness release gate) and mirrored by workers/intel-gateway/src/freshness-contract.js (/api/health). tests/test_public_freshness_contract.py fails if any consumer drifts from these values or from config/public_freshness_contract_vectors.json.

states.fresh: 0 <= age <= max_public_manifest_age_hours, or future-dated by no more than max_future_skew_hours (pipeline clock skew)
states.invalid_timestamp: generated_at present but not an ISO-8601 datetime with an explicit UTC offset
